verdict.rationale: Entra ID documents its own Lifecycle Workflows, whose processes "run automatically against users as they move through their lifecycle." That is first-party automated workflow execution tied to lifecycle events, but the evidence never says these workflows can run on a recurring schedule. It is therefore only thin support for scheduling recurring jobs. Missing for 10: documented recurring/scheduled execution (cron-like intervals or schedule configuration), scheduling of general jobs beyond identity lifecycle workflows, programmatic schedule management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Workflows contain specific processes that run automatically against users as they move through their lifecycle.
Lifecycle workflows (LCW) are identity governance capabilities that enable organizations to manage Microsoft Entra users across the three phases of a user's lifecycle with an organization
